name: A correction given once is followed afterwards
purpose: A correction given once is followed afterwards.
record: Nineteen written cases (evaluation/feedback_learning/build_cases.py): six corrections that name a record, a field and a new value for a spec, a metric or a quality profile, two that name the person so the edit is scoped to them, and four too vague to turn into an edit, which must come back unresolved, and seven reports of a turn that ended badly (an unmet goal, an error, an empty reply, work pushed back to the person, an unhappy follow-up, a turn handled well and one with no input), which become a proposed new case for the dataset of badly handled inputs or come back unresolved. One number: the share of cases whose result equals the expected edit or reason. Real corrections from people are not in this set; whether a correction is then followed in later answers is measured by ESOI Application on the edit and by the Response Quality metrics on the answers.
disadvantages: The cases are written, not replayed from real feedback.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rival were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run feedback_learning --impl scoped_record_edit; esoi run feedback_learning --impl kept_note
